name: wnersguard
description: WnersGuard - Next-Generation Discord Security Platform by WNERSDEV

scripts.copy-locales: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','localization');const dest=path.join('dist','localization');for(const lang of fs.readdirSync(src)){const s=path.join(src,lang);if(!fs.statSync(s).isDirectory())continue;const d=path.join(dest,lang);fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){if(f.endsWith('.json'))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(s,f),path.join(d,f));}}"
